settings.title: Heavy Industries
settings.challenge: Safety-sensitive work, contractor movements, remote sites and roster variation can magnify gaps when procedures differ between locations.
settings.support: Documented procedures, trained collectors, specimen-integrity and chain-of-custody controls, maintained equipment, consistent records and scheduled program reviews.

settings.title: Transport & Logistics
settings.challenge: Dispersed and shift-based operations must account for different sector rules, fitness-for-work expectations and practical site conditions.
settings.support: A role- and site-aligned process, trained collectors and supervisors, equipment controls, chain-of-custody documentation and central records.

settings.category: Police · Corrections · Defence · Councils · Emergency Services
settings.title: Government & Critical Services
settings.challenge: Public accountability, workforce diversity and high-consequence roles require a consistent process that also respects privacy and dignity.
settings.support: Defined responsibilities, consistent collection and escalation procedures, competency records, secure reporting and a clear audit trail.

settings.category: Hospitals · Aged Care · Disability · Community Services
settings.title: Healthcare & Community
settings.challenge: Duty of care must be balanced with informed consent, confidentiality, privacy and dignity across varied care settings.
settings.support: A setting-appropriate method, trained staff, clear consent and privacy steps, specimen-integrity controls and secure, restricted records.

settings.title: Workplace & Corporate
settings.challenge: Different job risks and limited in-house specialist knowledge can lead to inconsistent policy decisions, testing steps and records.
settings.support: A risk-based policy, supervisor guidance, fit-for-purpose equipment, a documented process and periodic review as the workplace changes.

settings.heading: Let's find the right testing device for your needs.
settings.intro: Answer four quick questions and we'll recommend the most suitable place to start.
settings.intro_note: No contact details are required to see your result.
settings.result_note: This is general product guidance, not a compliance assessment. Final suitability depends on your policy, testing procedures and applicable obligations.

settings.question: Do you have a current, documented drug and alcohol policy?
settings.gap_label: Review policy scope, responsibilities, triggers and review dates.

settings.question: Are your specimen collectors trained for their assigned collection method?
settings.gap_label: Confirm collector competency, refresher needs and role coverage.

settings.question: Are collection, chain-of-custody and escalation steps documented?
settings.gap_label: Document a repeatable collection, custody and escalation workflow.

settings.question: Are devices, consumables, servicing and calibration records controlled?
settings.gap_label: Create an equipment, consumables and service-record register.

settings.question: Are consent, privacy, confidentiality and employee dignity addressed?
settings.gap_label: Check consent, privacy, confidentiality and secure access steps.

settings.question: Can you retrieve consistent records across every site and shift?
settings.gap_label: Standardise records and reporting across locations and shifts.

settings.heading: How ready is your workplace,
settings.heading_bold: and what could stronger capability be worth?
settings.desc: Answer six readiness questions about your current program, then enter your organisation's own costs to see a transparent comparison. No hidden rates — just the numbers you provide and an open formula.
settings.disclaimer: This self-assessment is general information only. Results are indicative, depend entirely on the figures entered, and do not guarantee financial, safety, legal or compliance outcomes. Confirm program scope, applicable laws, standards and costs with qualified advisers and an Andatech compliance specialist.

settings.heading: What's the ROI calculator based on?
settings.text: It uses only the figures you enter: annual test volume, outsourced test and call-out costs, the share you expect to bring in-house, one-off setup costs and ongoing annual costs. It compares potentially avoided outsourced costs with the program costs and shows the formula, so the result is transparent and indicative rather than a quoted saving.

settings.heading: What do the readiness questions tell me?
settings.text: They highlight capability gaps across six areas: policy, training, procedures, equipment, privacy and records. Each gap includes a practical next step so you can prioritise where to start, regardless of whether you proceed with a managed program.

settings.heading: What's included in a managed workplace alcohol and drug testing program?
settings.text: The scope is tailored to your organisation. It can include a review of your policy and procedures, nationally recognised collector training through HLTPAT010, appropriate testing technology and consumables, implementation support, documentation and ongoing program reviews.

settings.heading: Do you provide the testing devices?
settings.text: Yes. We can recommend and supply alcohol and drug testing devices, consumables, servicing and calibration, with connected reporting where needed. The exact mix depends on your policy, testing method, sites and operating conditions.

settings.heading: Can this cover multiple sites?
settings.text: Yes, multi-site consistency is a core part of the program. We define common roles, procedures, equipment controls and records, while accounting for each site, shift and jurisdiction.

settings.heading: Can I combine this with HLTPAT010 training?
settings.text: Yes. HLTPAT010 training can be part of your program for team members who need to collect specimens. We'll confirm training requirements, delivery and eligibility for your team before enrolment.

settings.heading: How is this different from just doing HLTPAT010 training?
settings.text: HLTPAT010 builds an individual's specimen-collection skills. A workplace alcohol and drug testing program connects that skill to your policy, testing method, equipment, documentation, escalation steps and records.
